prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1063; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at an intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is pursuing a claim for the resulting losses. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of all policies that may apply to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page for each policy, within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence related to the collision. This includes vehicle and telematics data, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, repair estimates, and any dash camera or traffic camera footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials until the claim is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
